bdg2.rule: dev = 2 buildings drawn per (primary_use, climate_zone) stratum having >= 8 buildings with at least one q_ok meter; exam = all others

time.note: calendar years in each building's LOCAL time; models needing history fit on 2016 and are graded on 2017

bdg2.labels_ok: grade a building-meter only where meter_quality.q_ok (hourly) or q_ok_daily (daily/monthly tasks) is True

recs2020.note: prior = may feed generator priors / simulated training; dev = calibration and gates; exam = final report only. Survey weights refer to the whole sample: for population estimates within a split multiply weights by 1/fraction.

cbecs2018.note: prior = may feed generator priors / simulated training; dev = calibration and gates; exam = final report only. Survey weights refer to the whole sample: for population estimates within a split multiply weights by 1/fraction.

faults.unit: run (unit-day); grouped by facility+date so a day never spans splits
faults.rule: dev = seeded draw: ERS 1 fault day per season (+ its AHU-B baseline), 1 ERS normal day, FLEXLAB SZCAV 1 fault day, SZVAV 1 fault + 1 normal day, ORNL RTU 1 fault + 1 normal day, Nesbitt 2 fault + 2 baseline days (both AHUs); exam = every other gradable (experimental or real-building) run. Simulated / HIL sets are never graded.

stock.resstock_sample: reference (modelled; generator priors and simulator-vs-simulator check; never an exam)
stock.priors_rule: whole-stock metadata may be used freely for priors (it is modelled, not a real exam)
